summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration that defines a PHP service. It builds a Docker image from the current directory, exposes ports 80 and 443 for web traffic, and mounts the local src folder into the container so code changes are reflected immediately.

explanations.3: The 'build' section tells Docker Compose how to construct the image for this service.
explanations.4: The 'context: .' means Docker will use the Dockerfile in the current directory to build the image.
explanations.5: The 'ports' section maps ports from your computer to ports inside the container.
explanations.6: This maps port 80 on your computer to port 80 inside the container, so HTTP traffic reaches the PHP server.
explanations.7: This maps port 443 on your computer to port 443 inside the container for encrypted HTTPS traffic.
explanations.8: The 'volumes' section defines folders that are shared between your computer and the container.
explanations.9: This shares your local './src' folder with the container's '/var/www/html/' folder, so changes you make locally appear in the running container without rebuilding.
